evidence_interpretation.label: Known Empire control transport for a documented host, agent PID, server and active time; does not identify an executed command in each session.
evidence_interpretation.independence: All confirmed rows belong to the same documented attack episode; multiple beacons are not independent attack chains.
evidence_interpretation.time: PDF uses second precision and local -04:00 is corroborated by the separate exact-second download. eCAR and Bro raw clocks are both retained; no global clock correction applied.
evidence_interpretation.unmatched_ecar: The 25-host eCAR file spans more than the supplied conn hour. Missing hour-local conn matches are not automatically linkage errors or benign traffic.
evidence_interpretation.availability: Full conn statistics require at least ts+duration. Actual log emission/timeout/ingestion timestamp is unknown. HTTP/file zero matches do not refute encrypted control channels.
evidence_interpretation.files: Matched SSL application/pkix-cert records are TLS certificates, not payload/file-download attack events.
evidence_interpretation.hour_boundary: The supplied 17-18 log can contain connections that started just before 17:00; retained raw timestamps define the actual interval.
evidence_interpretation.nonmatches: Unmatched records remain unconfirmed; no residual normal labels assigned.
